Each is skinned to the Stations rig; the game's strongest poses stretch at most 10 % of it unclamped, so AnimalMoves.STIFF is empty
Foot points and spell anchors (AnimalRig) are measured on the new models and every spell checks out; each has a rainbow coat
Uploaded and seen in Studio walking, attacking and casting
verification: skin_forge --stretch worst: Guardian 8.98 %, Mammoth 5.37 %, War-Tortoise 5.85 %, Sun Rhino 8.11 % (the old Guardian 12.6 % with its legs clamped). check_spells ALL OK. Upload and Studio: see the PR.
